---
title: "Download AutoSite"
---

AutoSite is part of **ADFRsuite 1.0**, which runs on Linux and macOS. ADFRsuite contains
everything needed to set up docking experiments for small molecules and peptides.

## ADFRsuite 1.0 (release candidate 1)

Contents:

- ADFR 1.2 and associated scripts
- AGFR 1.2
- **AutoSite 1.0 and 1.1**
- ADCP 1.0 (Linux and macOS only)
- AutoGrid 4.2
- `prepare_ligand`
- `prepare_receptor`

| Platform | Installer | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| Linux 64-bit | [installer app](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/adfrsuite-1.0/ADFRsuite_Linux-x86_64_1.0_install) | `chmod a+x ADFRsuite_Linux-x867_64_1.0_install.run`<br>`./ADFRsuite_Linux-x867_64_1.0_install.run` |
| Linux 64-bit | [tarball](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/adfrsuite-1.0/ADFRsuite_x86_64Linux_1.0.tar.gz) | see [Installing from a tarball](#installing-from-a-tarball) |
| macOS | [tarball](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/adfrsuite-1.0/ADFRsuite_x86_64Darwin_1.0.tar.gz) | see [Installing from a tarball](#installing-from-a-tarball) |

## Installation notes

- The commercial installation does **not** install MSMS, the component that computes molecular
  surfaces. For a commercial MSMS license contact [Dr. Michel Sanner](mailto:sanner@scripps.edu).
  All other tools in the suite work fully in both installations.
- The default install location is `~/ADFRsuite-1.0`. If your home folder is not on a local disk,
  install to a folder on a local disk for better performance.
- ADFRsuite ships its own Python interpreter (2.7), installed in the `ADFRsuite-1.0` folder. It
  is isolated from your system Python and does not interfere with it. Start it with
  `ADFRsuite-1.0/bin/pythonsh`.

## Installing from a tarball

This example uses the macOS tarball; for another tarball change the file and folder names.

```bash
# unpack the tar file
tar zxvf ADFRsuite_x86_64Darwin_1.0.tar.gz

# step into the folder created by unpacking
cd ADFRsuite_x86_64Darwin_1.0

# run the installation script
#   -d destinationFolder  where to install ADFRsuite 1.0
#   -c                    how to compile the Python files: 0 for .pyc, 1 for .pyo
./install.sh -d myFolder -c 0
```
